# The co-traveller for your _entrepreneurial galaxy_

FortyTwo.VC is an early-stage fund dedicated to Indian founders building Enterprise Tech & SaaS for global markets. A cross-border fund with on-the-ground presence in India and the USA.

## Let's seek out 42!

In _The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy_, a group of hyper-intelligent pan-dimensional beings demands to learn the Answer to the Ultimate Question of Life, The Universe, and Everything from the supercomputer Deep Thought. It takes Deep Thought 7½ million years to compute and check the answer, which turns out to be _42_.


We know building companies can be hard — especially if it's about taking your company global. If you are building an Enterprise Tech or SaaS company for global markets, drop us a note.
